The SpaceX rocket that hit 26,500 km/h in space is now floating like a boat
caption:
The same Starship that ripped through space at 26,500 km/h is now quietly floating in the Indian Ocean, fully intact.

SpaceX built Starship to fly again and again, the way an airplane does. Most rockets are destroyed after a single trip. This one goes to space, survives the whole journey, and comes back in one piece, waiting to be picked up and launched again.

The contrast between those two clips is the whole point. Going from the fastest object most people will ever see to a calm float in the ocean is what reusable rockets actually look like in practice.
